name: notifier
description: Operator alerts (not end-user mail) through Pushover, email, and a generic webhook. notifyOperators() runs every enabled channel in parallel with a timeout and never throws. With auth installed, administrators configure the channels on the admin Settings page (stored encrypted in the DB, applied live); otherwise PUSHOVER_*/NOTIFY_* env.
env: # Alerts for the people who run the app: new inquiries, sign-ups awaiting
# approval, failed jobs. With auth installed, configure the channels on the
# admin Settings page (Operator notifications); these env vars are a field-wise
# fallback. A channel without its settings is skipped.
# Tests only: send Pushover requests to a mock instead of api.pushover.net

inject.text:
### notifier
- Alert operators (not end users) with `import { notifyOperators } from "../notify/notifier"` (path relative to your file): `await notifyOperators({ title, message, url?, urlTitle?, priority? })`. It never throws and returns each channel's result, so call it after the work it reports has succeeded.
- Keep personal data out of notifications where you can: link to the admin page (`url`) instead of copying form contents into `message`.
- Channels: Pushover, email (through the mailer), and a JSON webhook. Administrators configure them under Settings → Operator notifications (auth + admin-dashboard) and can send a test; `PUSHOVER_APP_TOKEN`, `PUSHOVER_USER_KEY`, `NOTIFY_EMAIL_TO`, and `NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL` are the env fallback.
- Add or replace a channel (e.g. Slack) with `setNotifyChannel(name, channel)` from `apps/api/src/app.extensions.ts`; `null` removes one.

instructions: Notify operators from anywhere in the API:  import { notifyOperators } from "../notify/notifier"  then  await notifyOperators({ title: "New inquiry", message: "...", url: "https://example.com/admin/..." }).

With auth and admin-dashboard installed, configure Pushover, email recipients, and a webhook under /admin/settings → Operator notifications, then press Send test notification. Install admin-dashboard before notifier so the Settings tab is registered.
Without auth, set PUSHOVER_APP_TOKEN/PUSHOVER_USER_KEY, NOTIFY_EMAIL_TO, or NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL in .env. Email uses the mailer's SMTP settings.
Add a channel from apps/api/src/app.extensions.ts:  import { setNotifyChannel } from "./notify/notifier";  setNotifyChannel("slack", { send: async (n, signal) => { ... } }).
